verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sentry has quota controls: a 'Billing Quota Management' docs page and 'Advanced quota management' listed as a pricing-tier feature. Both items are bare titles, though, with no detail on how quotas work, so per-project caps and hard spend limits are only implied. missing for 10: documented per-project event quota caps, explicit spend limits or budget ceilings, behavior during error storms (rate limiting, spike protection, overage handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
